memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "He and his descendants will have a covenant of a lasting priesthood, because he was zealous for the honour of his God and made atonement for the Israelites." - Num 25:13 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
God's covenant with Phinehas extended beyond his lifetime to his descendants: a lasting priesthood. Because of his zeal for God's honour and because he "made atonement" for the Israelites, his line was granted an enduring role in serving before the Lord. God remembered his faithfulness for generations to come.

The phrase "made atonement" is significant. Phinehas's action, in that unique moment of Israel's history, served to turn away God's wrath and restore the people. It was a means by which the broken relationship was addressed. Yet we know that no human act can provide atonement that lasts forever. This priesthood, though enduring, still pointed beyond itself.

For all its dignity, the priesthood of Phinehas and his descendants was temporary and imperfect. Those priests died, and their sacrifices had to be repeated endlessly. They served faithfully, but they could never finally take away sin. They were shadows pointing to a greater reality yet to come.

That reality is Christ, our great High Priest, who made atonement once for all by offering Himself (Heb 7:27). His priesthood is truly lasting, not passing from one generation to the next but held permanently by the One who lives forever. Where Phinehas made atonement for a moment, Christ made atonement for eternity. Trust in the priest whose work never needs repeating.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. How does the temporary priesthood point you to Christ's perfect one?
2. What does it mean that Christ's atonement is once for all?
3. How does having an eternal High Priest give you confidence before God?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord Jesus, thank You that You are my great High Priest, who made atonement once for all. I rest not in repeated sacrifices but in Your finished work that never needs repeating. Amen.
